title: Operational load versus model count
caption: The book's log-log sketch of monitoring load growing linearly, deployment coordination near N log N and dependency conflicts near N squared over two, crossing a team-capacity line around 50 models. The crossing is illustrative, not a measured threshold.
alt: Log-log curves of operational load components crossing a team capacity line near fifty models

title: Platform ROI threshold
caption: The book's benefit-cost ratio versus model count for 2 million and 5 million dollar annual platforms. Break-even lands at 20 and 50 models; at 100 models the smaller platform shows a ratio of 5. Our platform-breakeven chart plots the net dollars instead.
alt: Benefit-cost ratio curves rising linearly with model count for two platform cost levels

title: Model dependency graph
caption: The book's registry example where an embedding update fans out to retrieval, ranking and ensemble consumers. Our impact-set sketch adds the re-evaluation gate and the unrecorded-edge failure mode.
alt: Directed graph of models depending on a shared embedding model

title: Dual-store feature architecture
caption: The book's versioned feature definitions feeding one materialization engine, then an offline store for point-in-time historical scans and an online store for sub-10-millisecond lookups. Our packet compresses this into the freshness-latency contract.
alt: Feature definitions feeding batch streaming and on-demand materialization into offline and online stores

title: Point-in-time join versus naive join
caption: The book's noon example: a point-in-time join sees 4 clicks while a midnight-batch join sees 10, inflating total clicks today 2.5 times. Our freshness-latency equation names the availability-time rule that prevents it.
alt: Timeline showing point-in-time join seeing four clicks versus naive join seeing ten

title: Hierarchical monitoring pyramid
caption: The book's four levels, business, portfolio, model and infrastructure, each owned by a different role with different alert volume. Our slo-vector figure drills into the model-level budget rule instead.
alt: Pyramid of monitoring levels from business outcomes down to infrastructure

title: Build versus buy cumulative cost
caption: The book's matplotlib crossover for a 1,024-GPU cluster near month 26 to 27 of a 30-month horizon. Our build-vs-buy sketch keeps the stepped-versus-linear geometry and the occupancy boundary below the crossover.
alt: Cumulative cost chart with owned and cloud lines crossing around month twenty-six

title: TCO iceberg
caption: The book's ten-by-ten waffle where GPU cloud and object storage are the visible 50 percent and engineering labor, pipeline maintenance, retraining, incidents and compliance hide the other 50 percent. Our ml-tco equation names the four cost planes.
alt: Waffle grid showing visible compute and storage costs above hidden labor and maintenance costs
